subject: website
name: TiddlyWiki (Node.js server)
summary: TiddlyWiki's Node.js server (BSD-3-Clause), built from upstream's open source at a pinned commit, running inside Orivon and showing the wiki in an embedded view. It runs only what it ships and dials nothing: the server listens on this computer only and the wiki is stored in the app's own folder, so no remote party takes part: Level 4. Not private: the wiki is an ordinary page, so a tiddler linking an outside image, frame or plugin library would show your IP address. The default wiki makes none, but this was not watched with such content.

operations.name: Create, edit and search tiddlers
operations.note: Saved as files in this app's own folder on this computer by the app's own server; nothing is sent to another party.

operations.name: Serve the wiki on this computer
operations.note: The server listens on 127.0.0.1 port 8777 for the embedded view and stops with the app's last page.

connections.name: Own server (127.0.0.1, port 8777)
connections.note: A listener inside the app on this computer. Nothing leaves the computer.
